rule_outs: Dwelling 10 m from the best section
summary: Busy parked kerb beside lawns and trees; homes 30 m or more away.
reasons: Cars park along the whole kerb
Lawn and trees on the section's side

drivers.seclusion: East side backs onto open lawn and trees; detached house about 31 m away at 10 m, apartments 45 m or more.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerbside parallel parking in a lane where many cars already stand; no gate.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street near a shopping centre; some passing cars and construction-yard activity opposite.
drivers.convention: Cars line both kerbs; 4P signs apply Mon-Sat 8am-6pm only, so overnight is outside them.

flags: Steep: about 6% grade at the best section, 15.8% max near the start
Detached house about 10 m from the north end at 65 m; avoid that end
Mapped gate 294 m away has a way round it
sun_shade: Trees on the east side shade the kerb from the morning; open to the afternoon sun from the west.

best_section.where: East kerb of Henderson Street, beside the lawn north of the Belgrave Road corner
